newUser: New to SoulFire? Read the getting started guide.

connect.title: Connect to a SoulFire server
connect.description: Select which type of SoulFire server to connect to.

integrated.title: Integrated server (local)
integrated.description: Runs a SoulFire server on this device. Setup is automatic. This option requires the desktop or Android app.

dedicated.title: Dedicated server (remote)
dedicated.description: Connects to a remote SoulFire server with its address and token.

demo.title: Demo server
demo.description: Provides a read-only server with demo data. SoulFire does not save changes.

reset.success: SoulFire data reset successfully. Try starting again.

integrated.description: The integrated server runs on your computer. You can change the Java startup arguments below.

jvmArgs.title: JVM arguments
jvmArgs.description: Java VM arguments for SoulFire. Add <bold>-Xmx4G</bold> to use 4 GB of RAM. The default is 25% of available RAM.

mobile.description: To run the integrated server on mobile, you need to complete a few manual steps.

termuxCommand.title: Termux command
termuxCommand.description: Install the Termux app. Run this command in Termux to install the SoulFire server. Run generate-token api to create a token. Then enter the token below.

token.title: Token
token.description: Token to authenticate with the local server.

dedicated.description: Enter the address and token of the SoulFire server.

token.title: Token
token.description: Token to authenticate with the server.
